{{Hatnote|For the 2026 edition, see [[2026 Scrapyard Scrum]].}}
'''2025 Scavenger Superbowl Showcase''' was the first Scavenger Superbowl Showcase, an eight-player [[Scavenger Format]] bracket tournament on [[GEMP]] in March and April 2025. Players were invited by cumulative points in GEMP's monthly Scavenger league over 2024. [[Andy Talaga]] (andytalaga) won, defeating jwesselss in the Final on 9 April 2025.<ref name="ssb">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=85450 Scavenger Superbowl Showcase 2025], Domestique, forum.starwarsccg.org (7 March 2025; results 11 April 2025). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012160258/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t85450.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Scavenger Format]]
* '''Platform:''' GEMP
* '''Tournament organizer:''' [[Domestique]]<ref name="ssb" />
* '''Dates:''' 11 March – 28 April 2025<ref name="ssb" />
* '''Forum:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=85450 Scavenger Superbowl Showcase 2025 thread]

Each match was a single winner-take-all game; the higher seed chose a side. A consolation bracket for the four quarterfinal losers was added on 16 March 2025.<ref name="ssb" />
